title: Quantitative propagation of chaos in total variation for unregularized Vlasov-Riesz-Fokker-Planck systems
summary: We prove quantitative propagation of chaos in total variation for the unregularized repulsive Vlasov--Riesz--Fokker--Planck system on $\mathbb{T}^d$ and $\mathbb{R}^d$, $d\ge2$. For product initial data and potentials with singularity $|x|^{-s}$, $0<s<d/2$, we obtain an algebraic convergence rate for the $k$-particle marginals on a time interval independent of the particle number. The constants grow at most exponentially in $k$. The three-dimensional Coulomb case gives every rate $N^{-b}$ with $0<b<1/3$.
